message: fix(walking): establish GSAP layout before native scroll restoration

edits.find: import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
edits.replace: import React, { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

edits.find:
// engine.load() runs here, not in a render-phase useMemo, because this app owns the scroll
    // source and GSAP needs #scroll-scene committed to the DOM before ScrollTrigger.create().

edits.replace:
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import { flushSync } from "react-dom";

edits.find: The walking application loads and mounts core nodes before subscribing its UI/threshold observer.
edits.replace: The walking application synchronously commits its initial React root and acquires GSAP in a layout effect, so the producer's pin spacer exists before load/pageshow and native scroll restoration. This one bootstrap ordering boundary does not save or restore scroll itself, duplicate the trigger range, or flush Motion on each event. The application loads and mounts core nodes before subscribing its UI/threshold observer.
